exposure: Mean uterine artery pulsatility index (UtA-PI) >95th percentile
outcome: Early small for gestational age (SGA; <34 weeks of gestation)
Late small for gestational age (SGA; >=34 weeks of gestation)
Small for gestational age at birth (birthweight <10th percentile)
cohort: The study included 2,986 women with a singleton pregnancy who underwent fetal biometry and Doppler velocimetry at 20-24 weeks of gestation.
finding: Fetal biometry and Doppler evaluation at 20-24 weeks of gestation, particularly a cerebroplacental ratio <5th percentile, can predict early and late SGA as well as SGA at birth.
birth_weight: N/A (SGA at birth was defined as birthweight <10th percentile, but no general birth weight range for the cohort was specified)
